title: Migrate interactive mutation commands to structured bd args
description: Update create, assign, status, priority, and close flows to pass argv lists instead of formatting shell-like command strings with user-provided values.
design: Audit every write path that interpolates user input, convert them to argv calls, and keep UI behavior unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Titles, assignees, descriptions, and close reasons with spaces or quotes survive round-trip without malformed bd invocations.

title: Refactor beads--run-command and beads--run-json to accept argv
description: Replace string-based command assembly in the core bd execution helpers with structured argv lists so process-file receives exact arguments without shell-like parsing.
design: Keep one helper for raw stdout/stderr handling and a thin JSON wrapper; migrate internal helper call sites before changing interactive commands.
acceptance_criteria: The low-level bd helpers accept structured args; JSON mode is appended structurally rather than with string formatting; existing read paths still work.

title: Harden bd command invocation API
description: Track the follow-on work to replace shell-like bd command strings with argv-based invocation throughout beads.el.
design: Refactor the bd execution helpers first, then migrate interactive callers, then add regression coverage for quoted or space-containing input values.
acceptance_criteria: beads.el no longer constructs bd commands by interpolating user input into shell-like strings; callers pass structured arguments; the issue graph covers the refactor and its verification work.

title: Add regression coverage for quoted and spaced bd inputs
description: Add automated coverage around the command-construction boundary so titles, assignees, descriptions, and close reasons containing spaces or quotes do not regress.
design: Stub the bd execution layer where practical; focus the tests on argument construction and error propagation rather than requiring a full CLI workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests or equivalent repeatable verification cover at least titles and close reasons containing spaces and quotes, and fail on the old string-splitting behavior.
